title: Third Conditional (Unreal Past)
theory:
 The third conditional is used to talk about imaginary situation in the past, things that
 did not happen and their hypothetical results. It expresses regret, criticism, or missed
 opportunities related to the past.
Third Conditional is used to describe hypothetical past situations that did not happen

Although we make suggestions about its negative consequences. This shows Regret, Criticism or Missed
opportunity

 Structure

 If + Subject1 + had + V3 + Object , Subject2 + would have + V3 + Object.
 Clause1 Clause2

 Inversion

 Had + Subject1 + V3 + Object , Subject2 + would have + V3 + Object.
 Clause1 Clause2

 Note
Often Would in place of 'could/might' use of ability, possibility and uncertainty
